sourcedFrom: Ruger 10/22 Autoloading Rifle Instruction Manual — PM1269 (2026)
cleanIntro: The Takedown separates into two halves without tools. Ruger documents the sequence and the tension adjustment that goes with it.

steps.title: Check this manual applies to your rifle
steps.action: Ruger restricts this book by model number, not by model name. Confirm yours is in range before following it.
steps.prose: A 10/22 older than that range is a different document. The app cannot read your model number — you can.
steps.cite: Ruger 10/22 Autoloading Rifle Instruction Manual — PM1269 — Cover note, p.1

steps.title: Clear it completely
steps.action: Point the rifle in a safe direction, remove the magazine, lock the bolt back and confirm the chamber is empty by sight and by finger.
steps.prose: The 10/22 rotary magazine sits flush — look for it, do not assume it is out.
steps.quote: lock the bolt to the rear
steps.cite: Ruger 10/22 Autoloading Rifle Instruction Manual — PM1269 — Disassembly, p.20
steps.warn: Always unload a firearm before cleaning, lubrication, disassembly, or assembly.

steps.title: Bolt back, locking lever forward, rotate, pull
steps.action: Lock the bolt to the rear. Push the locking lever forward toward the muzzle. Rotate the barrel assembly, then pull it forward away from the receiver.
steps.prose: All four in that order — the bolt has to be back before the lever will release anything.
steps.quote: To remove the barrel assembly, first lock the bolt to the rear. Second, push the locking lever forward, towards the muzzle.
steps.cite: Ruger 10/22 Autoloading Rifle Instruction Manual — PM1269 — Takedown, step 6, p.20

steps.title: Barrel assembly off
steps.action: Pull the barrel assembly forwards, away from the receiver.
steps.prose: That is the rifle in two halves — as far as routine cleaning needs.
steps.quote: pull the barrel assembly forwards, away from the receiver.
steps.cite: Ruger 10/22 Autoloading Rifle Instruction Manual — PM1269 — Takedown, step 6, p.20

deepAbsentReason: PM1269 documents the takedown separation and the barrel-fit adjustment. It publishes no disassembly past that, so this listing has NO deep clean.

cleaning.name: BORE & CHAMBER
tasks: Solvent patch, correctly sized brush, then dry patches until clean
Rimfire fouling is waxy and builds fast — the chamber needs as much attention as the bore
Clean from the chamber end where the design allows

cleaning.name: BOLT / ACTION
tasks: Wipe the bolt face and around the extractor
Clean the receiver raceways and the magazine well
Light oil on bearing surfaces only

cleaning.name: MAGAZINES
tasks: Wipe magazine bodies dry — no oil where ammunition sits

reassembly: Reinstall the barrel assembly. You should feel some resistance when turning it, but it should not be difficult.
If the fit needs adjusting, remove the barrel assembly and tighten or loosen the adjustment knob accordingly.
fncheck: With the magazine out and chamber confirmed empty, confirm the halves lock together with the expected resistance and the bolt cycles freely.
